summary: Frontend tests (Playwright on Expo web, 390x844 / 767 / 768 / 1024) covered all 10 requested features. All of them work: the operator dropdown on mobile and chips at >=768, the madre starter alert and its navigation to Produzione, the real oven-time schedule, the two separate starter forms with validation and persistence, adaptive feeding history, flour deduction on In Puntata (once only, with the warning and a trace section), deduction of both flours for a new Focaccia batch, the archive day selector with per-day PDFs (verified with pdftotext), the timer restart on advance, and sync. No blocking bugs. I found a few logic, formatting and design issues. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none.

ui_bugs.issue: For a batch In Forno, the start time is computed as max(timerEndsAt, now) minus the bake duration. Once the oven timer expires, 'In forno dalle HH:MM' moves forward every minute instead of staying fixed (b3 shows 21:47 now, but would show 22:05 at 22:30). Use timerEndsAt directly for In Forno. Reference: /app/frontend/src/utils/lab-automation.ts:66-69

Estimates that fall after midnight show only HH:MM with no day marker. For example, b4 (12 h in cella) shows 'Infornata ~ 12:52', which is tomorrow, so it is ambiguous. Add 'domani' or a date. Minor: the label renders as 'Infornata ~ 22:29' (with a space) rather than the specified '~HH:MM'. Reference: daily-sheet.ts:19

Core temperature and ratio show dot decimals ('26.5°C', '1:1:0.45') in the mobile cards, the tablet table and the PDF, while the hero badge shows '1:1:0,45'. Use it-IT formatting everywhere. Reference: index.tsx:392,413; daily-sheet.ts:66
The title 'Buongiorno, laboratorio' is hardcoded and still shows during the Turno Notte (22:00). Reference: index.tsx:233

integration_issues.issue: advance() computes the deduction from the render-time closure state.stock, outside the setState updater, then overwrites current.stock. Two advances in quick succession, before a re-render, could lose one deduction. Compute deductFlour inside the updater using current. Reference: index.tsx:343-348

issues: White text on success #10B981 (starter-alert-madre when ready, sync-badge) has a contrast ratio of about 2.5:1, which fails WCAG AA for 12-14px text. Use a darker green, e.g. #047857.
The advance-* and trace-* buttons are 32px tall, below the 44px touch-target minimum.
On mobile, an advanced card moves to a column off-screen to the right and gives no feedback apart from the flour notice. Consider auto-scrolling or a toast.
The archive preview capitalises the month ('Lunedì 23 Novembre 2026'). Italian months are lowercase.
The archive PDF header 'Operatore:' shows the current operator rather than that day's. Consider renaming it 'Stampato da'.
Seed notes n1-n3 have hardcoded shifts (Notte/Mattina) but times relative to now, so the PDF shows rows like '21:01 Mattina'.

action_items: Fix estimateBakeTime for In Forno so the start time stays fixed after the timer expires (use timerEndsAt minus the bake duration, no max with now).
Add a day indicator ('domani') to schedule estimates that cross midnight.
Format the core temperature and ratio with it-IT decimals in the history cards, table and PDF.
Move the deductFlour calculation inside the setState updater (use current.stock) to avoid lost updates.
Improve contrast of white text on the green success background (starter alert, sync badge).
Raise advance-*/trace-* buttons to a minimum height of 44px.
Optional: make the greeting depend on the shift, lowercase the month in the archive date, and fix the seed note shifts.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx is 554 lines, but the StyleSheet and many components are packed into single very long lines (e.g. lines 369 and 553), which hurts readability and diffs.

onDay() assigns undated records (demo returns r1-r3, batches b1-b5) to today, so they appear on every 'today' PDF forever. This is acceptable for the demo, but real records should always carry 'at' / 'createdAt'.
The archive 'Riepilogo impasti' attributes a batch to its createdAt day, not to the day its flour was deducted.
Feeding validation, the once-per-batch deduction guard (flourUsage present, even when empty) and the timer restart via stageTimerFrom are all correct.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested features pass (10/10); 1 medium and several low-priority issues

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ feedings (Pasta Madre and Licoli) and a Focaccia batch (10 kg), and advanced b4 and b2. At the end I restored the original seed with reset-demo, as the main agent allowed, and confirmed via GET /api/panificio/state: s2=42 kg, b4 Da Impastare, no TEST_ feedings.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Navigation testIDs: nav-oggi/ricette/produzione/altro. Altro sub-tabs: more-haccp, more-costi, more-report. The reset-demo button is on the dashboard header and uses window.confirm (accept the dialog with asyncio.ensure_future). Batch form chips: batch-recipe-0..3 (3 = Focaccia). Expected values: b4 deduction 6,1 kg; Focaccia '10 kg' deducts 3,3 kg Tipo 0 and 1,4 kg Semola. The dashboard schedule is sliced to 4 rows; the PDF contains all of them.
rca_of_issue: Bake-time drift: lab-automation.ts:66 sets currentEnd = max(timerEndsAt, now). For In Forno, the start is currentEnd minus the bake duration, so after expiry it becomes now minus the duration. Fix: for index === ovenIndex, use the timerEndsAt timestamp directly.
